opportunities.name: arXiv topic search → Semantic Scholar citation lookup → log note
opportunities.description: For a research topic and year, search arXiv advanced search filtered to that year, open a top paper, look up its title on Semantic Scholar to get the first author and citation count, then save a note in the form '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <author>, <N> citations'.
steps: Go to arXiv, click Search, then Advanced search
Check the date-filter checkbox, select the 'specific_year' radio and type the year into YYYY
Click Search and open the top relevant result (arXiv ID link)
On Semantic Scholar, type the title into the search box and click Submit
Open the matching paper and read the first author and citation count
In Notes, click 'New note', type '<topic> (<year>): <title> by <first author>, <citations> citations' and press Enter

instances.values: topic='retrieval augmented generation', year=2023 → RIGHT: Retrieval-augmented Generation for Mainstream Hashtag Recommendation, Run-Ze Fan, 11 citations
topic='protein structure diffusion', year=2024 → Accelerating Inference in Molecular Diffusion Models..., Ian Dunn, 7 citations
topic='graph neural networks traffic forecasting', year not yet entered (left unfinished)

opportunities.name: Court case lookup → related US Code statute → log note
opportunities.description: For a court case and a related statute citation, find the case on CourtListener to get its reporter citation and decision date, look up the statute section title on Cornell LII, then save a note in the form '<case>: <citation>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<section title>)'.
steps: On CourtListener, click the 'Keyword(s) search with operators' box, type the case name and press Enter
Copy the reporter citation (e.g. 585 U.S. 296) and the decision date
On Cornell LII, type the statute citation into the search box and submit
Open the matching /uscode/text/... result and copy the section title
In Notes, click 'New note', type '<case>: <citation>, decided <date>. See <statute> (<section title>)' and press Enter

instances.values: case='Carpenter v. United States', statute='18 U.S.C. 2703' → 585 U.S. 296, June 22, 2018
case='Bostock v. Clayton County', statute='42 U.S.C. 2000e-2' → 590 U.S. 644, June 15, 2020
case='Miranda v. Arizona' (opened the 1966 opinion; no statute lookup or note during the session)

opportunities.description: Search Peerspace for venues that fit an activity type in a given city.
steps: Click the 'Enter your activity' combobox, select all and type the activity
Pick the matching activity option if one is suggested
Click 'Enter a city, zip, or address', select all and type the city
Click Search and browse the results
